name: stance-retreat-rally
description: retreat when damaged, without a place of repair: three tanks far out with retreat at 50% are hurt to about 35%; they pull back to the rally point in front of the base and wait there out of the fight. (Needs the commits with MSG_ASSIST_BASE_DEFEND / MSG_ASSIST_STANCE; until then "this build has no command".)
steps: until not atsnapshot tanks tol=150 max=600
log: ^ASSIST stance set mask=2 value=2 percent=50 for 3 units
^ASSIST stance retreat: unit \d+ at \d+% goes to the rally point
^ASSIST stance retreat: unit \d+ is out of the fight
